summary: SUFFIX_TRANSFORMS dict and infer_pipeline() function. Parses a path's suffix chain right-to-left into a Pipeline. Baseline map: .gz/.gzip → Gzip, .gpg/.asc/.pgp → GPG. Stops at first unknown suffix and returns (pipeline, stripped_path). Raises ValueError if a GPG suffix is found without a GPG instance.
extension_points: SUFFIX_TRANSFORMS dict can be extended to map custom suffixes to new transform types
lifecycle_notes: Write-side inference is intentionally absent — writes always take an explicit pipeline= argument
documentation_hooks: infer=True on facade.read() routes through infer_pipeline; document the suffix chain semantics for users
data.parquet.gz.gpg yields Pipeline(GPG, Gzip) — outermost first
risks: Unknown suffixes silently stop parsing — users may expect full chain to be parsed

evidence.detail: Tests suffix chain parsing and SUFFIX_TRANSFORMS
